name: Shinozuka Reiko
source:
Corporal Reiko Shinozuka is [url=https://vndb.org/c14801]Leiji[/url]'s official support liaison. Due to her clumsiness and lack of communication skills, Reiko's extraordinary intelligence at working with computers has been overlooked by everyone. Of course, that means she's a potential suspect for the damage of the base's computer system. She takes an immediate liking to Leiji due to their common Japanese ancestry.

[Edited from [url=http://engbishoujo.tripod.com/criticalprofiles.html]Game's Manual[/url] and [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/562753-critical-point/faqs/19503]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
